question: Which of the following instruments is used for the measurement of piston ring end gap in the cylinder?
solution:
The correct answer is __Feeler Gauge**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Feeler gauge__ is a tool used to measure the gap or clearance between two parts.
 
• It consists of a set of thin metal blades of different thicknesses.
 
• The blades are marked with their respective thicknesses and can be used individually or in combination.
 
• To measure the piston ring end gap, the feeler gauge blade is inserted into the gap to determine its size.
 
• It ensures accurate measurement and helps in maintaining the proper clearance for effective engine operation.
 
• Feeler gauges are commonly used in automotive, mechanical, and industrial applications.
 
• They are an essential tool for checking tolerances and ensuring precision in assemblies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Dial Gauge:**

 
 
• Used to measure small linear distances or deviations.
 
• Commonly used for alignment and runout measurements.
 
 
 
• **Micrometer:**
 
 
• Provides precise measurements of small dimensions, such as thickness or diameter.
 
• Typically used in machining and mechanical engineering.
 
 
 
• **Vernier Caliper:**
 
 
• Measures internal and external dimensions, as well as depths.
 
• Offers high accuracy and versatility in measurements.
